items.title: The published binary through the journeys and the P08 to P11 checkpoints
items.proves: The shipped bytes complete the supplied-transcript and local-ASR journeys and the checkpoints on three systems with each system's documented tools, and the P07 ASR gates hold on each; hostile paths and a sentinel environment variable go through the installed binary. The pass rule is per system (the maintainer's decision of 2026-10-04): on each system every stage that can run there passed; the P07 ASR gates hold on each operating system; P11's durable-workspace stage must pass only on the qualified profile (Ubuntu 24.04, local ext4 with write barriers), where a hosted runner's disk has none (L-113) and RQ-09 and RQ-12 of the same version cover the durable path instead, and on Windows and macOS it must show the durable profile refused with MISSING_CAPABILITY and nothing created.
items.does_not_prove: Real recordings; other hardware; that Homebrew's builds are reviewed (they are recorded, not endorsed); that the durable stage's own script ran on a disk with write barriers (RQ-09 and RQ-12 ran the durable path there, not that script).

producer.description: Hosted workflow on Ubuntu 24.04 (managed tools), Windows (pinned tools) and macOS 15 (Homebrew tools); the tests are compiled from the tag's source (from the workflow's ref for a tag that predates the override) and run the installed vsift through a binary override; tool versions recorded; a weekly drift run.

producer.description: The Fuzz workflow with a raised duration cap, plus a gap review of untrusted-input parsers and new targets where one is missing.

evidence.note: All 31 targets ran 3,601 s each on hosted Ubuntu 24.04, dispatched at the tag v0.2.0-rc.2 (7c722d1fc46a, the candidate's own commit) with seconds=3601 (the same as for the first candidate): 2,918,298,500 runs in 111,662 s of fuzzing (1,952 job-minutes with the set-up job), no crash, timeout or out-of-memory, peak resident memory at most 878 MB.
